title: RC General Contracting Inc
question: Choose a direction for the home and services pages. Full systems and 360px layouts are in docs/design-directions.md. Choosing approves the design direction; copy gets its later review.

options.label: A. Rooms in focus
options.thesis: A large completed-space photograph follows a bold, compact introduction.
options.viewport: A compact logo and clear navigation, a wide title, a visible enquiry action, then the kitchen photograph across the page.
options.risk: The kitchen leads strongly; service copy must make the commercial and construction scope equally clear.

options.label: B. Plans into places
options.thesis: A clear service introduction sits beside separate design and construction images.
options.viewport: A deep green introduction with pale text and a lime enquiry button, beside a rendering and a construction photograph on a pale board.
options.risk: Architecture-board layouts are familiar; strong image scale and plain language must keep this useful rather than decorative.
